# Techno Enjaz | تكنو إنجاز

> الصرح الهندسي المتكامل لتطوير الأنظمة البرمجية فائقة الأداء، الحلول السحابية، إنترنت الأشياء، والذكاء الاصطناعي في حماة، سوريا.
> The premier engineering hub for cloud enterprise systems, IoT automation, and AI engineering solutions.

## Overview & Identity
- **Name**: Techno Enjaz (تكنو إنجاز)
- **Domain**: Software Engineering, Cloud Architectures, Embedded Systems & IoT, AI Solutions, Web & Mobile Platforms.
- **Headquarters**: Hama, Syria (حماة، الجمهورية العربية السورية)
- **Coordinates**: Latitude `35.128992`, Longitude `36.754001` (Geo Region: `SY-HM`)
- **Official Website**: https://technoenjaz.com
- **Phone & WhatsApp**: +963 958 794 195

- **Instagram**: @TECHNO_ENJAZ (https://instagram.com/TECHNO_ENJAZ)

## Core Platforms & Flagship Systems (الأنظمة الرائدة)

1. **Hisab Cloud ERP (نظام حساب السحابي)**
   - *Category*: Cloud Architecture & Enterprise Resource Planning
   - *Stack*: React, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker
   - *Key Features*: Integrated billing, multi-warehouse inventory, real-time analytics, RBAC permissions, lightning-fast query caching.
   - *Live Demo*: https://hisab.technoenjaz.com

2. **Arduino Cloud Lab (مختبر المحاكاة السحابي)**
   - *Category*: IoT & Embedded Systems
   - *Stack*: WebSockets, C++, Canvas API, WebAssembly, MQTT
   - *Key Features*: Real-time bidirectional telemetry, hardware signal visualization, virtual sensor node simulation, zero-latency micro-controller bridging.

3. **ProjectForge Hub (منصة إدارة المشاريع الهندسية)**
   - *Category*: Team Collaboration & Sprint Management
   - *Stack*: Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL, Tailwind CSS
   - *Key Features*: Kanban workflows, Git integrations, velocity tracking, automated milestone notifications, role-based audit logs.

4. **CableXperts (نظام الشبكات والبنى التحتية)**
   - *Category*: Network & Infrastructure Management
   - *Stack*: React, Python, Network Topology Engine
   - *Key Features*: Fiber & copper pathway calculation, latency monitoring, automated outage alerts.

5. **Dermocean (نظام الرعاية الجلدية والتشخيص الذكي)**
   - *Category*: Healthcare & Computer Vision
   - *Stack*: PyTorch, FastAPI, React Native, OpenCV
   - *Key Features*: AI-assisted skin anomaly screening, appointment automation, confidential patient records.

6. **Interactive 3D Portfolio & CV Hub (الهوية الرقمية التفاعلية)**
   - *Category*: Frontend Engineering & 3D Web
   - *Stack*: Three.js, React Three Fiber, Framer Motion
   - *Key Features*: Spatial 3D portfolio navigation, smooth physics, bilingual dynamic profile render.

---

## Engineering Divisions (الأقسام الهندسية التخصصية)

- **Cloud & Backend Engineering**: Microservices, clean architecture, high-concurrency APIs, resilient distributed databases.
- **IoT & Robotics Engineering**: Microcontroller firmware, industrial sensors, Modbus/MQTT protocols, telemetry dashboards.
- **Artificial Intelligence & LLM Agents**: Production RAG architectures, local LLM fine-tuning, computer vision classification, deterministic guardrails.
- **UI/UX & Interactive Systems**: High-framerate fluid web interfaces, micro-interactions, responsive accessibility, bi-directional RTL/LTR design.
